Title: Public preview: Azure Monitoring Agent supports custom and IIS logs

Body.Content:
Azure Monitoring Agent (AMA) is a native way to collect log files for Log Analytics. This new custom and IIS log capability is designed for you to collect text-based logs generated in your service or application. Likewise, IIS logs that provide internet access for your service can be collected and transferred into a Log Analytics Workspace table for later analysis.

For more information, visit custom log and IIS.
